# BIY Home Store (Kota Tinggi) Sdn Bhd

> Hardware, paint and power tools shop in Johor, Malaysia, with 4 branches (Kota Tinggi HQ, Kota Tinggi JTH, Kota Masai in Pasir Gudang, Pontian). Prices on WhatsApp only.

Site: https://autoseo.my/preview/biy-home-store/
Sitemap: https://autoseo.my/preview/biy-home-store/sitemap.xml


## Facts

- WhatsApp and call: 012-568 8961 (https://wa.me/60125688961)
- Kota Tinggi HQ landline: 07-882 7586
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/biyhomestorekt
- Brands: Jotun, Nippon Paint, Dong Cheng, Bosch
- Opening hours: please WhatsApp to confirm. Prices: WhatsApp only.
- Branch Kota Tinggi (HQ): No. 11 & 11A, Jalan Seri Warisan, 81900 Kota Tinggi, Johor, Malaysia
- Branch Kota Tinggi (JTH): No. 4-2 & 4-3 (Ground Floor), Jalan Tun Habab, 81900 Kota Tinggi, Johor, Malaysia
- Branch Kota Masai (Pasir Gudang): No. 22 & 24, Jalan Ekoperniagaan 1, Taman Kota Masai, 81700 Pasir Gudang, Johor, Malaysia
- Branch Pontian: No. 72 & 73, Jalan Emas 3, Pusat Perniagaan Kota Emas, Pontian, Johor, Malaysia
